h: "Your beginning small, your end very great"

p: and your end shall grow very great”
At a hundred years he fathered a son;
“and your end shall grow very great”—
and fathered several sons with her
about Isaac our father, peace be upon him,

and they are in the kelipah,
the one set against the other,
As is stated in the holy Zohar
“For in those mountains of the East
and from that land of the East
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ חֵלֶק ג קצד עַמּוּד א)
from the wisdom of all the children of the East
and from all the wisdom of Egypt.
(the verse) mentions the wisdom of Egypt,
is rooted in the Written Torah.

p: though she was modest in her deeds,
as is said in the Midrash,
to the land of the East,

and from them Israel will draw out

h: Circumcision for the sons of Keturah

p: more than in the sons of Esau,
with Abraham our father, peace be upon him,
that all “the souls they had made in Haran,”
וְכֵן כָּתַב (בְּפִרְקֵי דְרַבִּי אֱלִיעֶזֶר פֶּרֶק כט)
And so it is written (Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer ch. 29):
and they broke the covenant of circumcision.
And this is what (the Gemara) said:
“He transmitted to them a Name in impurity”—
that even when they are in impurity
there will still be in them

h: "Whatever you can make shine, make shine"

p: of what they said (Bereshit Rabbah, parashah 61):
“‘And he sent them away from Isaac his son’—
‘Whatever you are able to make shine,
so that you are not scorched
that it refers to the eastern direction,
that a remnant should remain of them
“so that you are not scorched by Isaac’s coal”—
that is, the fire of holiness,
“A young Torah scholar who boils with anger—
it is the Torah that makes him boil,
“and My words which I have placed in your mouth.”
in the Introduction to Tikkunei Zohar:
“And when it is taken from Gevurah,
it is called the Oral Torah”

p: and did not understand his intent
just as with the sons of Keturah,
only they did not merit it,
and Solomon drew out from them
but you have not merited to understand.
and of the chief of the sorcerers—
who was a Jewess and a sorceress.
to the land of the East,
But they did not understand his intent
since they did not grasp the depth of his intent.
And this is why the Midrash expounded
about Isaac our father, peace be upon him,
and “your end shall grow very great”
for from them Israel draws out
all the depth of the Oral Torah,
the wisdom of all the children of the East,”

h: "Very": the good that comes out of its opposite

p: And this is why it says “very,”
in the manner of what is said:
and behold, it was very good,”
about everything that is the opposite of good,
that it too will be “very good.”

And in the manner of what is written (Zohar II 184a):
except that which comes out of darkness,
except that which comes out of evil.”
